title: Catalyst Pattern Catalog
description: Schema for .chthonic/grammar/patterns.json — accumulated catalog of catalyst patterns the grammar should handle. Each entry is a tested input + expected parse outcome. Catalog grows by hand-curation (back-fill from iteration history) + auto-extraction (failures from full-SSOT smoke).

name.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the pattern.

description.description: One-line explanation of what this pattern represents.

example.description: Actual text from catalyst (or constructed minimal example) that exhibits the pattern.

expected_top_rule.description: Top-level grammar rule the example should match (e.g., 'bold_parened_id'). Use 'DEFERRED' if the pattern is failing and the design is open.

expected_inner_rules.description: Inner rules that should appear in the parse tree of a successful match. The dsl-pattern-test binary checks these.

status.description: Current status against the grammar. working=passes, failing=catalyst pattern but grammar doesn't handle it, deferred=intentional Phase 0 gap, regressed=was working, now failing.

since_iter.description: Which iteration introduced this pattern (or 'full-ssot-baseline', etc. for non-iter origins).

source_line_ssot.description: OPTIONAL. Source line in .chthonic/SSOT.md where this pattern was observed.

category.description: Pattern category for grouping (must match a key in top-level categories map).

iter_1_fix.description: OPTIONAL. Free-form note about which iteration's fix enabled this pattern.

first_failing_grammar_hash.description: OPTIONAL. Grammar hash at which this pattern was first observed to fail (for failing/regressed statuses).

last_verified_grammar_hash.description: OPTIONAL. Grammar hash at which this pattern last passed. Updated by dsl-pattern-test.
